# AutoShorts Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

As contributors and maintainers of the **AutoShorts** project, we pledge to make participation in our community a harassment-free, collaborative, and constructive experience for everyone, regardless of background, identity, or level of experience.

## Standards of Behavior

### Positive Contributions
- Demonstrating empathy, professional courtesy, and technical rigor.
- Being respectful of differing viewpoints and architectural trade-offs.
- Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback.
- Focusing on what is best for the project's reliability, performance, and user community.
- Respecting mobile resource boundaries (ARM64 memory constraints, battery life, and storage quotas).

### Unacceptable Behavior
- Trolling, insulting, derogatory comments, or personal attacks.
- Harassment in any form, public or private.
- Publishing private information of others without explicit permission.
- Submitting intentionally malicious code, backdoors, or unsolicited credential harvesting.

## Enforcement Responsibilities

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing our standards of acceptable behavior and will take appropriate and fair corrective action in response to any behavior that they deem inappropriate, threatening, or harmful.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all community spaces (GitHub repository, discussions, pull requests, issue trackers), and when an individual is representing the project in public spaces.

## Reporting & Inquiries

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the project maintainers via private communication or GitHub Security Advisories. All reports will be reviewed promptly and treated confidentially.
